An '''army''' was commanded by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] around [[3000 BBY]] during the [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes. It was defeated by Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] of [[Otoh Sancture]] and his new [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]], which was formed from the united Gungan tribes.
